title: October 31, 2026 1:12 PM
body: I created this whole website just so i could show my feelings to whoever i wish to. its been a rough morning for me especially after i talked to kathy. she said you asked her to make sure im okay. i wish you wouldve just said it yourself but i guess i get why you didnt. im not really okay. i havent been. i dont like being here at all and i want to go back home but i dont get to. not until the school year is over. ill get visits and holidays and stuff but i want to live at home again. im trying to make the most of my experience here but its so hard. yeah theres parties and shit but none of it is for me. im not a partier or at least i dont want to party without my people. i sit in my dorm alone because i have no roommate with the girl i love less than two minutes away and i cant go see her because she doesnt love me back. i only have my family and my two best friends. ones in utah and the other one is back home and its neither of their issues to deal with what im dealing with. so i just suck it up and figure it out because thats all i can do. theres nobody here to help me but me. im smart though so ill figure it out. you always would ask if i was gonna be okay and every single time i respond with the same exact thing. i always am. i think about everything we used to have. you used to call me your favorite person ever. you used to say you would get that cuteness aggression thing. i just keep wondering to myself how i let it all go. i never meant to ignore things or make you feel unseen. i was more worried about making you feel that way so i avoided doing things i thought would make me weird or trying to hard so you would still like me. i was an asshole to everyone. for no reason at all i made everyone dislike me because i thought thats just who i am. im not that person. im a good guy and i want to help. i doubted myself more than anybody and in doing that i kept pushing myself away. being so self centered was the key to losing myself. ive learned more about myself in two or three months here than i have in four years in high school. i would do so much just for a hug. a conversation. anything. i wish we would still talk. i wish we would still do anything. i dont want to live a life with you gone. you have to be somewhere in it. even if i only see you once a month and we only talk over the phone. i would do anything to have that. you dont have to be gone but you think thats the only way for you to figure it out. you dont accept my help. you dont see who i am. you only look at what you think i am. which is way worse than you think. i want to talk to you. preferably face to face but i get if you cant do that. i just want you to see that im not the same person. we both made too many mistakes. i wanted to work through them but you didnt want to deal with that so you walked and for some reason im back here again. building a website to get my point across. apparently this is what it takes. i talked to joel last night and i showed him what i wrote earlier in the day. he said it was gut wrenching and that he doesnt even know if youd respond. i never planned on showing them to you. i might just share to the whole world. i feel like i have so much to share. so much to talk about. so much to tell and yeah its the most informal thing youll ever read and i dont care one bit. this is who i am this is who i want to be. i dont hate myself anymore or people and i enjoy being around. i find joy in helping people but the one person i want to help the most doesnt seem to want anything to do with me. yeah i miss you. yeah i want you back. theres so much i just want to say i cant even write it all out. if this doesnt make you see something in me then ill know youre truly gone. i dont think thats the case. i feel like somewhere you miss me to but you convince yourself you dont so you stop thinking about it. i want to be there for you. i want to support you somehow. i want to be together again in any possible way. i just dont know how to get a hold of you. its not emmas job or kathys job or anybodies but mine. this is my fight these are my words im gonna figure it out. im gonna be okay because i always am.
